summary: VP Data Product Owner candidate with ~7 years bridging institutional investment teams and the enterprise analytics and data products they run on. At Moody's Analytics, led client onboarding and the Calypso-to-PFaroe migration, scoped business requirements into Product Owner development requests, and serves on the model governance committee setting documentation, benchmarking, and validation standards. Re-engineered spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python and SQL pipelines with AI-assisted automation. CFA charterholder, dual MSc; asset management and insurance client depth from Ortec Finance and EY.
core_skills: Business Requirements Scoping for Product Owners

sections.heading: Analytics & Data Product Delivery
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, giving institutional clients forward-looking liquidity visibility they previously lacked.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python pipelines (pandas, PostgreSQL/SQL) with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, closing an internal governance audit.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation, reducing development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Governance, Quality & Standards
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), validating assumptions and economic defensibility prior to production release -- the same trust-in-the-numbers bar a data product must clear before business adoption.

sections.heading: Stakeholder Engagement & Escalation
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into decision-ready narratives for investment committees and business stakeholders.
Acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Client Onboarding & Requirements Translation
bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms adopting PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, translating business requirements into scoped development requests and advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM and validated model outputs post-deployment, underpinning each client's adoption of the new platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation programs for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery, and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Developed IFRS 17 advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral for the practice.

Delivered ALM and strategic asset allocation studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-horizon balance-sheet risk.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test allocation robustness.
Presented study findings on-site to investment committees at pension-fund clients, converting stochastic scenario output into allocation recommendations.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
